_comment: Paste your Power BI embed URLs here, one per portal page. Get a URL from Power BI Service: open the report -> File -> Embed report -> Publish to web (public)  OR  Share -> Embed. Leave a value as "" to show the AI report only for that page. Save the file and refresh the portal - no restart needed.
_howto: A .pbix file cannot be embedded directly. The report must be published to the Power BI Service first, then use the generated https://app.powerbi.com/... URL.
